theme_and_concept.primary_concept: Premium futuristic 3D IT company with enterprise aesthetic. Combining cyberpunk, swiss poster precision, and architecture studio layouts.

typography.instructions: Install Google Fonts. Ensure headings are tightly tracked. Never use Inter for headings.

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow for icons and box-shadow for glowing cards. Example: hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)]
visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle deep radial gradients in backgrounds to create depth. No harsh linear gradients on large surfaces.
visual_enhancers.grid_lines: Use CSS background patterns (linear-gradient) for faint, technical grid lines in sections like Architecture or Process.

layouts.bento_grid: Grid with asymmetric spans. Use gap-6 or gap-8. Span logic: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 for hero features, col-span-4 for supporting cards.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for sections.

motion.hover: Cards should have a 3D lift (-translate-y-2), increased border glow, and subtle rotation (hover:rotate-1 or 3d transforms using framer-motion).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up and scale-in using framer-motion (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}).
motion.css_3d: For the hero 'interactive CSS 3D network sphere', use framer-motion to create multiple nested rings/circles with border-radius: 50%, dashed borders, and rotateX/rotateY/rotateZ animations over time.

sections.nav: Sticky with backdrop-blur-xl (Glassmorphism). Include 'ganesh tech' logo. Links: Home, About, Services, Solutions, Industries, Technologies, Projects, Contact.
sections.hero: Headline: 'Transforming Technology. Powering the Future.' CSS 3D interactive sphere with glowing dashed rings and floating lucide icons (Cloud, Shield, Server, Database) mapped in 3D space using Framer Motion.
sections.about: Title: 'Technology Built Around Your Business'. 3D floating architecture showing Flow: Business -> Cloud -> Data -> AI -> Security -> Apps. Stats bento box.
sections.services: Six premium 3D cards with glowing borders on hover. IT Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Cloud, AI, Software Dev, Digital Transformation.
sections.cybersecurity: Full-width dramatic section. Background image: `cybersecurity` URL. Huge CTA: 'Protect Your Business'.
sections.cloud: Futuristic visualization with `cloud` image. Flow of animated data streams (using absolute positioning and motion.div).
sections.industries: Hover cards that lift with 3D perspective.
sections.tech_stack: Horizontal animated marquee/ecosystem of technologies using clean glass cards.
sections.process: Visual 3D timeline (01 to 06) with glowing animated connector lines.
sections.cta: Large CTA. Background with rotating 3D sphere (CSS).
sections.contact: Premium contact form (HTML/Shadcn). Store enquiries in app state or just preventDefault. Address and details.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on dark backgrounds is legible (white or very light gray).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for all scroll and hover animations. It is crucial for the 'premium 3D' feel.

Build a CSS-based 3D sphere component for the hero section: create multiple absolute-positioned divs with border-radius 50%, border dashed cyan/blue, rotated on X/Y axes, and animated continuously to simulate a 3D network globe.
Use Lucide-react for icons, given a glowing drop-shadow filter.
Do not use generic template styles. Apply padding generously (py-24, gap-12).
Ensure 'ganesh tech' is the company name used, and 'zzzor' is used as a reference number in the footer or contact section.
Use pure Tailwind for layout structures, avoid shadcn 'Card' wrappers for complex asymmetric designs.
Do not use transparent background on header; use high-saturation glassmorphism: 'bg-[#090D1A]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends. DO NOT apply universal transition 'transition: all'. NEVER use AI assistant Emojis. Use 2-3x more spacing. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
